info.title: Jamii Air API
info.description: Mobile app routes and, under /api/v1/admin, the admin portal (separate auth: tags "admin" and "admin auth").

dateOfBirth.description: YYYY-MM-DD; the user must be 18 or older

acceptTerms.description: Terms of Service and Privacy Policy accepted (BR-AC-06)

refreshToken.description: Opaque, 30 days, rotated on every refresh; keep in secure storage

cancelDeletion.description: Restore an account scheduled for deletion (BR-AC-08)

installationId.description: This installation; its push token is removed
This installation: its push registration is kept, every other one removed

avatarMediaId.description: An AVATAR upload (POST /media/uploads); null removes the avatar

isBlockedByMe.description: You blocked this user: show Unblock; posts and lists stay empty

shareUrl.description: "Copy profile link": opens the profile in the app, else a landing page

kind.description: VIDEO is only ever a POST (BR-CT-07)

mimeType.description: Must match `kind`: images are JPEG/PNG/HEIC/WebP (the app sends JPEG after downscaling), video is MP4 or QuickTime

byteSize.description: 15 MB for an image, 150 MB for a video

uploadUrl.description: PUT the file here, before expiresAt

headers.description: Send exactly these headers with the PUT (they are signed)

mediaIds.description: POST uploads (POST /media/uploads), in the order they should appear: 1-10 photos as a carousel, or exactly one video. A post never mixes the two (BR-CT-09/10)

blurhash.description: Placeholder while the image or poster loads

url.description: What to show: the feed image (≤ 1080 wide) for IMAGE, the 720p MP4 for VIDEO. Null until processed

posterUrl.description: VIDEO only: the still to show before playback (BR-CT-08)

durationMs.description: VIDEO only: length in milliseconds (≤ 60 s)

width.description: Of the image or video: reserve the aspect ratio

status.description: Only the author ever sees PROCESSING or FAILED

type.description: PHOTO covers one photo and a carousel; media.length says which

shareUrl.description: Opens the post in the app, else a landing page with store links

caption.description: null or empty removes the caption

type.description: VIDEO shows a play badge on the tile

status.description: Your own grid only: PROCESSING, FAILED, and HIDDEN ("Removed for violating Community Guidelines")

tag.description: The tag as stored: lower case, without the "#"

postCount.description: Published posts on this tag, before the viewer's own blocks

canDelete.description: You wrote it or own the post

replyCount.description: Visible replies under this comment. It ignores the viewer's blocks, so the thread can open shorter than this

items.description: Newest first; the app shows them oldest → newest and loads older pages on scroll up

parentId.description: The comment being answered (BR-FD-08). Replies are one level deep: passing a reply answers its parent instead (BR-FD-09)
The comment this answers; null for a top-level comment

commentCount.description: The post's new comment count, replies included

parentReplyCount.description: On a reply, the parent's new replyCount; 0 otherwise

canDelete.description: You wrote it or own the post

items.description: OLDEST first — a thread reads as a conversation — and pages forwards

commentCount.description: Replies are counted too, and deleting a comment deletes its thread

parentReplyCount.description: On a reply, the parent's new replyCount; 0 otherwise

type.description: REPLY: someone answered your comment (BR-FD-08). Its commentId is the reply

postThumbUrl.description: 320 × 320; null when the post is gone

targetAvailable.description: false: the post or comment was deleted or hidden ("no longer available")

all.description: Mark every notification read (Activity tab opened)

locale.description: The app language on this phone: push text uses it

targetId.description: The user, post or comment id

deletionDueAt.description: Logging in before this cancels the deletion

enrollmentRequired.description: First login: set up the authenticator (enrollment), then POST /totp/enroll

accessToken.description: Keep in memory only; the refresh token is an HttpOnly cookie

metrics.description: Daily series per KPI (camelCase names: registeredUsers, newSignups, dau, posts, likes, comments, follows, retentionD1, retentionD7, retentionD30, newUserFollowPct, newUserPostPct)

target.description: Post (with image), comment, or user — including hidden or deleted content

reportId.description: Resolve this report in the same action

temporaryPassword.description: Shown once: give it to the new admin, who sets up 2FA at first sign-in and then changes it

status.description: ACTIVE also unlocks a locked account

details.description: e.g. { fields: [...] } for VALIDATION_FAILED, { minVersion } for APP_VERSION_UNSUPPORTED
